title: Chanvoy wait_dm_v1 Parameters
description: Strict parameters for one one-shot wait on a direct message by exact username. Username resolve and create-if-missing are inside daemon admission. There is no team or channel selector.

username.description: Exact Mattermost username of the peer. Not a channel id, UUID, user id, or {uid}__{uid} DM name. The runtime additionally enforces a 256 UTF-8 byte limit.

timeout_secs.description: Required positive u64 duration. The absolute deadline starts at RPC entry and covers username resolve, direct-channel create-if-missing, baseline bind, ownership, subscribe/backfill, and block.

contains.description: Optional case-sensitive literal body substring. Empty is refused at runtime. The runtime additionally enforces a 256 UTF-8 byte limit.

pattern.description: Optional Rust-regex body pattern. Combines with contains using logical AND. Empty is refused. Compiled size is limited at runtime.

mention.description: When true, only posts that mention this bot complete the wait. Logical AND with contains and pattern. Default false/absent. Non-matches are not tips.

after.description: Exclusive baseline post id on this DM conversation. Bound before registry acquisition. Null or absent means tip-at-arm with seam protection after the waiter is admitted. This is not an inbox cursor.

oneOf.description: Opaque wait id from a prior wait_already_active conflict. Compare-and-replace only; a malformed, stale, absent, or other-channel id is wait_conflict_changed.
